shortDescription: Manage sap license keys for SAP application instance with saplikey program.

options.name: allow_asterisk
options.description: Whether to allow the use of asterisks as wildcards in the system, hardware_key, and product parameters. This is to prevent accidental deletion of licenses.

options.name: filename
options.description: Path to the license file to install or remove.

options.name: hardware_key
options.description: The hardware key of the SAP system.

options.name: license_content
options.description: The content of the license file to install or remove. This parameter is not logged.

options.name: product
options.description: The product ID of the SAP system.

options.name: profile
options.description: Profile filename as mentioned in SAP documentation for saplikey program.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the license should be present or absent.

options.name: system
options.description: The system ID of the SAP system. Or a wildcard asterisk C(*).
